source.authorization_text: 需要我干什么 你能自己克服困难继续么 我给你充分授权
source.account_binding_question: 生产中有 4 个账户，唯一超级管理员是 admin（用户 ID 1）。是否将 admin 指定为你在本项目中的所有者和人工审批账户？

authorized_work: Resolve technical prerequisites within the existing sprint, including bounded configuration and corrective implementation.
Prepare an isolated non-production staging environment and non-billable tests.
Prepare and execute technically validated bounded production actions with current candidate checks, backups, stop conditions and rollback.
not_claimed: The designation alone is not a completed authentication-context or canonical authority ledger.
No successful reconciliation, production acceptance, current human login, elapsed observation period, external approval signature or paid/broker result is asserted.
Existing exact technical execution gates, account isolation and append-only contracts still apply.
